newsitem.title: USA: Safeskin signs supply pact with Costco.
newsitem.headline: Safeskin signs supply pact with Costco.

text.p: Safeskin Corp said it will supply examination gloves to Costco Cos Inc under an agreement valued at up to $6 million annually.
Costco operates 270 warehouses throughout the U.S., Canada, Mexico and the United Kingdom.

Safeskin said the supply agreement reflects its intent to pursue new market opportunities beyond its present penetration of the hospital, doctors' office, dental, and high technology and scientific markets.
Safeskin, a leading manufacturer of high quality disposable latex medical examination gloves, gained 1-5/8 to 20-3/4.
